body: mailchimp-waitlist.php added to edis-ask-emily. Overrides /wp-json/edis/v1/waitlist at rest_api_init priority 20. Mailchimp API v3 PUT upsert (safe re-subscribe), auto-detects data center from key suffix, tag support, falls back to wp_options when not configured. Admin settings fields. Config via EDIS_MAILCHIMP_API_KEY + LIST_ID + TAG. EDIS commit 22b7de5. Apple #478.
title: S23-05: Mailchimp waitlist integration — EDIS edis-ask-emily plugin
